visual_description: A large, ruggedized battery 'cube' with reinforced corners and heavy-duty handles. The front face features a glowing LCD screen showing '98% Charge' and 'Input: 400W'. It has multiple AC outlets, USB-C ports, and a high-amperage 12V port. A solar cable is plugged into the 'Input' side.

constraints.visual_detail: Dust-proof covers on all ports; cooling fans visible behind a mesh grate.
constraints.background: Sitting on a wooden crate inside a ventilated field tent.
